conf.description: Building Automation (Metasys) audit api-pull direct route: REST v4 audits JSON parse with enum de-prefixing, preData/postData flattening and itemReference host split, per recommendations.direct.cribl

conf.comment: Metasys REST API v4 audits resource, paged/checkpointed on creationTime by the collector. No Elastic integration or Cribl pack exists for Metasys. API returns JSON already; the work here is enum de-prefixing, preData/postData flattening and ECS renaming.

functions.description: Extract one Metasys audit record JSON body into top-level fields

Per recommendations.direct.cribl: de-prefix actionType/classLevel/originApplication enum-set strings, split deviceHostname out of itemReference for host.name, flatten preData/postData, promote postData to source.ip only for log-in/log-out actionTypes, derive event.outcome from status+errorString together
Batch rename of the directly-mapped columns, run after the eval above so host.name/source.ip could still read the original itemReference/postData
Event time from the ISO-8601 creationTime (platform constraint: never target @timestamp)
Set event.dataset (no hyphen) and drop staging fields consumed into their ECS/custom targets above
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
